quest.title: Concresoil
quest.description: After constant research and testing, Akim has finally made some progress...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I think I'm about to succeed...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Traveler! Hold on a second, Traveler!

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Here's the thing. I've been mixing the different soils you brought previously in various proportions over the last few days.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I failed many times, but I did eventually work out a viable mixing ratio!

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Concresoil with this ratio lacks plasticity before it hardens, but after that, it becomes strong and durable.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I might need to add more soil with Slime Condensate in it...

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Traveler, could you please bring me three more portions of Slime Condensate?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: With more Slime Condensate, I'm sure that I can definitely create the ideal soil!

choices.text: What are you looking for this time?

talks.objective: Give three portions of Slime Condensate to Akim

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Did you get the Slime Condensate?

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: Great! This is it. Give me a sec. I'll get it done in no time!

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: As adhesive as it is, the moist soil breaks easily once it hardens. However, if we mix it with the Whopperflower soil, the solidified soil becomes more flexible.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: It's just that the mixture can't really be molded before it starts solidifying...

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: But with the addition of the soil from the Slimes' habitat, the mixture can be molded much better before its solidification.

dialogues.speaker: Akim
dialogues.text: I don't know what happened, but if I have to describe the process, the soil became Slime-like...

choices.text: So, I guess we can call it "Slimesoil," hmm?

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Some property of the Slimes seems to have affected the mixture in some way. That's why I was wondering if adding Slime Condensate would make it more effective.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: And as it turned out, the mixture's plasticity and stability changed with the amount of Slime Condensate added.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Which means that it can make more than just building materials, but pottery and many other things as well!

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Thanks. I suppose this is what those wise folks mean when they say "many a little makes a mickle."

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: We shouldn't underestimate this modest-looking soil. Someday, I might be able to build a tower to touch the skies with it!

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: I've also decided to call this mixture "Concresoil."

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: The next thing is to see what this Concresoil can make...

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Ah, it seems that a possible solution to the problems that have plagued peoples' homes recently is within sight.

response.speaker: Akim
response.text: Thank you once again, Traveler. Please take these as your reward.

choices.text: Sounds like something Paimon might enjoy.
